Markets.title: Chevron expands Venezuela presence with $7 billion plan to double oil output in five years
Markets.summary: Chevron plans to invest more than $7 billion in Venezuela to double its oil production to roughly 600,000 barrels per day within five years. Following the announcement, the company's shares increased by 0.51% to reach $212.13 on Wednesday.

Markets.title: Prediction platform Kalshi targets US oil market with perpetual WTI contract
Markets.summary: Prediction platform Kalshi is seeking U.S. regulatory approval to launch a perpetual West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures contract. If approved, the 24/5 product would become the first oil-linked perpetual futures contract traded on a regulated U.S. platform.

Markets.title: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel sees AI, power demand as new engines of growth
Markets.summary: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel is targeting artificial intelligence and increased energy demand as new growth drivers for the company. While consumers continue to face economic pressures, the firm is investing in Alphabet and focusing on long-term opportunities like Japanese trading houses and data center power supply.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices fell significantly on Wednesday, driven by US-Iran tensions, rising crude prices, and global bond stress. Analysts warn that the market will remain bearish unless the Nifty index stays above 24,000.

Markets.title: JM Financial Asset Management garners Rs 700 crore from maiden pre-IPO fund
Markets.summary: JM Financial Asset Management raised Rs 700 crore in the first close of its maiden pre-IPO fund. The fund will invest sector-agnostically in companies with strong fundamentals that plan to go public within 18 months.

Markets.title: Banks rush to swap higher-risk credit assets for Bank of England cash
Markets.summary: British banks are increasingly using higher-risk assets as collateral to obtain cash from the Bank of England, reaching levels not seen since March 2020. The central bank accepts these loan-backed securities while maintaining strict risk management to protect its interests.

Geo-Political.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
Geo-Political.summary: Iranian media reports a U.S. strike killed four people, including two children, at a home during a wedding. In response, Iran launched missiles and drones at U.S. targets in the Middle East while the U.S. denied targeting civilians.

Geo-Political.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
Geo-Political.summary: Saudi Arabia stated that an Iranian attack on a Saudi oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz killed two Filipino sailors. The kingdom condemned the strike, which involved unknown projectiles hitting the vessel on Monday.

Geo-Political.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
Geo-Political.summary: The EU and NATO promised to increase pressure on Russia following a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport. Berlin blamed Moscow for the incident, citing a pattern of growing recklessness.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
Geo-Political.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin recently issued a veiled threat directed at the United Kingdom. According to analyst Steve Rosenberg, this warning is part of an ongoing Russian campaign designed to cause uncertainty and stress regarding Moscow's intentions toward the West.

Geo-Political.title: US sailors arrive in Thailand's Pattaya after record 250 days at sea
Geo-Political.summary: The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln arrived in Pattaya, Thailand, after spending a record 250 days at sea. The port visit allows the U.S. sailors to rest in the coastal city known for its nightlife and tourism.

Geo-Political.title: Woman charged with juror intimidation in Lindsay Clancy trial
Geo-Political.summary: Dawn Light has been charged with juror intimidation for allegedly photographing jurors outside a Plymouth courthouse. Court rules strictly prohibit taking pictures of jurors in this manner.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A marketer tested ChatGPT to find the best WordPress SaaS course and discovered their own unpaid course was recommended as the top result. This experience highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies toward AI optimization (AIO) over traditional SEO.

AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top 10 AI tools designed to help creators improve their content production in 2025. It explains that utilizing these technologies is now essential for staying competitive in the evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs, provides platform alternatives, and answers common user questions.

Data & Insights.title: Centre defends GDP estimates, says revisions reflect updated data, methodology
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government defended its recent GDP estimates, denying allegations that it artificially inflated the June quarter's real growth rate to 7.8% and nominal expansion to 10.3%. Officials stated that the revisions were based on updated data and methodology rather than manipulation.

Data & Insights.title: BJP Vs Congress: ‘Not comparing apples with apples?’ Piyush Goyal hits back at Congress criticism of GDP numbers
Data & Insights.summary: Minister Piyush Goyal criticized the Congress party for its reaction to India's latest GDP data. The new figures show India's economy grew faster than expected despite global economic concerns.

Data & Insights.title: How a stalled mall in Srinagar fetched a massive amount in auction - more than double govt expectation
Data & Insights.summary: A stalled mall project in Srinagar was auctioned on a full-lease basis for ₹421.75 crore. This winning bid was more than double the government's initial expectation.

Data & Insights.title: '7.8% growth but still import-dependent': Sridhar Vembu explains Modi’s Swadeshi push
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi highlighted India's 7.8% real GDP growth in Q1 FY27 while urging citizens to boost local consumption and avoid non-essential spending to conserve foreign exchange. Although the RBI revised its FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.7%, Sridhar Vembu noted that the country remains import-dependent.

Data & Insights.title: Why a sovereign rating is not the last word on a nation’s creditworthiness
Data & Insights.summary: Sovereign credit ratings measure a country's ability to service its debt obligations rather than serving as a badge of national prestige. Instead of viewing these ratings as the final word on creditworthiness, it is more useful to analyze their individual dimensions.

Data & Insights.title: Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay will be in UK from September 10 to 16 - What's on the agenda?
Data & Insights.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay will visit the United Kingdom from September 10 to 16. Additionally, a state delegation led by Minister Keerthana will travel to Taiwan on September 4 to attend the Semicon conference.

India.title: Ayodhya Ram Temple Gets Air Force Veteran As CEO, 3 New Members
India.summary: Retired Air Marshal Mishra has been appointed as the CEO of the Ayodhya Ram Temple. He is one of four new members, including three others, recently added to the temple's administration.

India.title: Delhi High Court Fines Firm For Demoting Woman After Maternity Leave
India.summary: The Delhi High Court fined a firm for demoting a female employee after she returned from maternity leave. The court ruled that women coming back from maternity leave must generally be restored to their previous positions.

India.title: 6 IAS Officers Among 19 Chargesheeted In Rs 504-Crore Scam In Haryana
India.summary: Haryana authorities have filed a chargesheet against 19 individuals, including six IAS officers and four bank officials, in connection with a Rs 504-crore scam. The case also names nine other Haryana government officials for their involvement in the financial fraud.

India.title: Ex-Chief Economic Adviser Backs GDP Data, Calls Methodology "Cutting-Edge"
India.summary: Former Chief Economic Adviser Krishnamurthy V Subramanian has defended India's GDP calculation methodology as cutting-edge. He dismissed opposition accusations that the government deliberately manipulated last year's data to artificially inflate this year's growth rate.

India.title: "Alarming Apathy": India Condemns Century-Old Temple's Demolition In Pakistan
India.summary: India condemned the demolition of a century-old Hindu temple in Pakistan, calling the incident "alarming apathy." New Delhi urged Pakistani authorities to immediately restore the desecrated site and ensure the safety and cultural heritage of minority citizens.

India.title: Underpasses, Shelters, Queues: Lives Of Families Hoping For AIIMS Treatment
India.summary: Affordable and subsidised treatment at AIIMS makes it the last hope for many families seeking medical care. These families often endure difficult living conditions like underpasses and shelters while waiting in long queues for treatment.

General.title: Burnham pressed on economy at first PMQs as UK borrowing costs rise
General.summary: During his first Prime Minister's Questions, Burnham was pressed on the economy amid rising UK borrowing costs. He defended his record by stating he had already cut taxes, including VAT on energy bills and business rates for hospitality.

General.title: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
General.summary: King Charles is praising an unprecedented exhibition of the historic Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum in London. British and French leaders will attend the museum to view the historic artifact together.

General.title: What famous scenes are in the epic Bayeux Tapestry?
General.summary: The 70-meter Bayeux Tapestry depicts the events of the 1066 Norman Conquest and Battle of Hastings. This historic artifact will soon be displayed at the British Museum.

General.title: 'Nothing but mud and silt' - the village swept away by deadly floods in Nepal
General.summary: Deadly floods in Nepal have swept away an entire village, leaving behind only mud and silt. Rescue efforts are ongoing as locals await the recovery of missing victims.

General.title: Lucy Letby 'boyfriend' doctor named as court order lifted
General.summary: Dr. Mark Deakin, a consultant at Alder Hey hospital, was identified as the boyfriend of convicted murderer Lucy Letby after a court order was lifted. He had been referred to by that description during her trial.

General.title: Farage tells BBC 'we live in a complainants' society' after questions over Reform funding
General.summary: The Reform UK leader said a "whole ecosystem" didn't want "new kids on the block succeeding".
